operands.text: YOU JOINED NEO TO FIGHT THE RAM MENACE. YOU ARE BEING BRIEFED IN THE CHICAGORG SPACEPORT.
'EARTH HAS BEEN DEVASTATED DURING THE 25TH CENTURY. BUT NOW, THANKS TO YOU AND THOUSANDS LIKE YOU, WE CAN BEGIN TO REBUILD THIS PLANET.'
YOU ARE ASSIGNED TO SALVATION STATION FOR SALVAGE DUTY AND MARCHED TOWARDS A WAITING SHUTTLE.

FIGHTERS SCREAM IN LOW FROM THE NORTH. CONTROL TOWERS COLLAPSE IN BALLS OF CRIMSON FLAME! YOUR OFFICERS ARE DOWN AND THE OTHER RECRUITS ARE FLEEING. YOU HAVE BEEN THRUST HEADFIRST INTO A RAGING BATTLE!
THE SECURITY DOORS ARE SEALED.
THE DOOR HAS BEEN FUSED SHUT BY THE BATTLE.
ENEMY TRANSPORTS HAVE ARRIVED. TERRINES JUMP OUT AND ENGAGE THE DISORGANIZED NEO TROOPS.
TERRINES MOVE IN FOR THE KILL.
NEO FORCES COME TO YOUR AID.
THE WHINE OF LASERS AND BOOM OF GRENADES ECHOES THROUGH THE BUILDING.
YOUR TEETH RATTLE AS A FIGHTER SCREAMS OVERHEAD.
FROM SOMEWHERE COMES A SNIPER'S BEAM.
RAM HAS AIR SUPERIORITY. NEO'S ANTI-SHIP DEFENSES ARE SILENT AND THEIR FIGHTERS DESTROYED.
IT IS DANGEROUS TO BE OUTSIDE. THE SHIPS ARE NOW STRAFING THE INFANTRY.
A FIGHTER SCREAMS PAST AND SPRAYS YOUR TEAM WITH LASER FIRE.
THE HEAT FROM THE EXPLOSIONS DRIVES YOU BACK. YOU ARE VERY EXPOSED OUT HERE ON THE TARMAC.
MEN'S ROOM
WOMEN'S ROOM
SOMEONE TOSSED A GRENADE INTO THE ROOM. THE STALLS ARE SHATTERED AND WATER COATS THE FLOOR.
YOU OPEN THE DOOR INTO THE MUZZLE OF A TERRINE'S PISTOL. HE SMILES AND SQUEEZES THE TRIGGER.
EXPLOSIONS HAVE SHATTERED THE ROOF AND THE DEBRIS BURIED SEVERAL BODIES.
A NEO OFFICER LIES AMONG SOME WRECKAGE. 'I'M HOLDING ON HERE, BUT MY LEG IS SHATTERED.'
'SABOTEURS CUT THE AUTOMATIC DEFENSES. EAST OF HERE IS THE MANUAL OVERRIDE SYSTEM. GET OVER THERE AND ACTIVATE THE MISSILES.'
THE OFFICER IS UNCONSCIOUS. A QUICK CHECK SHOWS THAT HE IS IN STABLE CONDITION.
YOU ARE AMBUSHED BY TERRINES!
LECTURE HALL
AN ORDERLY IS CHECKING ON A YOUNG MAN LYING IN A FETAL POSITION. 'SOME OF THESE KIDS CAN'T TAKE REAL WAR. I'LL HOLD ON HERE, YOU MOVE OUT.'
TWO RECRUITS WERE SHOT IN THE BACK AS THEY TRIED TO ENTER THE BUILDING.
AS YOU APPROACH, TERRINES ATTACK FROM THE DOORWAY.
THE BATTLE HAS FUSED THE DOOR SHUT. YOU MUST ENTER THROUGH ANOTHER DOOR.
AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY
YOU BURST IN AMONGST A SQUAD OF TERRINES. IN THE BACKGROUND YOU CAN SEE A RAM TECHNICIAN WORKING ON A MISSILE CONTROL PANEL.
WITH ONE HAND, THE TECHNICIAN BEGINS FIRING AT YOU. HE IS STILL MODIFYING THE CONTROLS WITH THE OTHER.
IF YOU SHOOT AT HIM YOU MAY DAMAGE THE CONTROLS WHICH OPERATE THE BASE'S MISSILES.
SHOOT
CHARGE
TAKE COVER
WHO SHOOTS?
'S SHOT IS TRUE.
THAT ONE CAN'T ACT.
THE SHOT GOES AWRY AND STRIKES THE PANEL. SPARKS FLY AND SMOKE RISES. ANOTHER SHOT WILL DESTROY IT COMPLETELY.
SHOOT
CHARGE
FLEE
THE PANEL ERUPTS IN FLAME! THERE IS NOW NO WAY TO LAUNCH THE ANTI-SHIP MISSILES.
AS YOU FLEE THE TECHNICIAN WHOOPS FOR JOY. FROM SOMEWHERE IS A SHOUT, 'THE MISSILES ARE FALLING ON CHICAGORG! THE CITY IS AFLAME!'
YOU HEAR THE RUMBLE OF A LARGE SHIP PASSING OVERHEAD, FOLLOWED BY THE WHISTLE OF FALLING BOMBS.
THE WORLD EXPLODES AROUND YOU!
THE TECHNICIAN COLLAPSES. HIS BLOOD FLECKED LIPS CURL IN A SMILE.
HE HISSES, 'IF THE MISSILES WON'T FIRE ON CHICAGORG, THEY WON'T FIRE AT ALL!'
HE GRABS A GRENADE AND PULLS THE PIN. YOU CAN EITHER DIVE ON IT OR RUN FOR COVER. WILL ANYONE MAKE THE SACRIFICE?
DIVE ON GRENADE
FLEE

MUFFLED THE EXPLOSION. YOU SET THE MISSILES TO ANTI-SHIP MODE. SOON YOU HEAR THE CRUNCH OF ENEMY SPACESHIPS CRASHING.
ROBBED OF AIR SUPERIORITY, THE RAM ATTACK IS QUICKLY BEATEN BACK. YOU ARE CONGRATULATED AND YOUR WOUNDS ATTENDED TO.
YOU ARE GIVEN A SMALL REWARD.
YOU ARE PARADED TO A NEWLY ARRIVED SHUTTLE AND FERRIED TO SALVATION III.
THE TECHNICIAN FIRES WILDLY AS YOU RUSH HIM.
YOU STRIKE THE TECHNICIAN DOWN.
YOU DUCK BEHIND THE DOOR FRAME AND ARE PROTECTED FROM THE TECHNICIAN'S FIRE.
SHOOT
CHARGE

MEDICAL OFFICER
THE ROOM IS FULL OF WOUNDED TROOPS. AN ORDERLY SHOUTS, 'WE'RE FULL IN HERE. YOU'RE MORE USE OUT THERE!' SHE PUSHES YOU OUT THE DOOR.'
YOU HEAR AN EXPLOSION.
THE BLACKENED ROOM HOLDS NO SURVIVORS. OBVIOUSLY A TERRINE BOOBY-TRAPPED ONE OF THE WOUNDED.
YOU FIND SOME GRENADES THAT DID NOT DETONATE.
WAITING ROOM
ONLY THE DEAD ADORN THIS ROOM.
YOU SEE MONITORS FOR THE FUELING TANKS. THEY ARE ALL RED-LINED -- THE FUEL STORES HAVE BEEN STRUCK IN THE ATTACK.
WORKERS TRIED TO USE THIS GARAGE FOR COVER. TERRINES OBVIOUSLY SPOTTED THEM. THE WALLS ARE STAINED CRIMSON.
THIS BUILDING HOUSED FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT. THE TERRINES HAVE GUTTED THE STRUCTURE AND DESTROYED THE ROBOTS.
TO THE SOUTH IS THE OFFICER'S LOUNGE.
TO THE WEST IS THE CANTEEN.
AN OFFICER COLLAPSED HERE, WOUNDED BY SHRAPNEL. HE COUGHS WEAKLY AND MOTIONS YOU CLOSE.
HE WHISPERS, 'MISSILE CONTROLS.. ENEMY MUST HAVE CUT AUTOMATICS.. ACTIVATE THE DEFENSE.. ARGGHH!!!'
HE CONVULSES ONCE AND LIES STILL.

operands.text: A NEO OFFICER GREETS YOU.
'I AM CARLTON TURABIAN. WELCOME TO SALVATION III. WHEN YOU ARE READY, COME SEE ME AT HEADQUARTERS FOR YOUR FIRST ASSIGNMENT.'
'RAM HAS KIDNAPPED THE DESERT RUNNER ATHA. THEY THREATEN TO KILL HER IF YOU DON'T TRAVEL TO JUNO.'
TURABIAN LOOKS PAINED. 'I'M AFRAID YOUR CURRENT MISSION IS MORE IMPORTANT. THERE JUST ISN'T ENOUGH TIME.
'GO TO MERCURY FIRST. THAT'S AN ORDER.' TURABIAN THEN LEAVES THE BAY.
BUCK COMES UP AFTER TURABIAN LEAVES.
'SOMETIMES RULES ARE MADE TO BE BROKEN. INDIVIDUALS ARE MORE IMPORTANT THAN ORDERS.'
HE GIVES YOU THE THUMBS UP SIGN AND SAUNTERS OFF.
'YOU'VE DONE WELL. I SEE YOU'VE CAPTURED A RAM ROCKETSHIP. IT'S NAMED THE MAELSTROM RIDER.
'I'VE ASSIGNED YOU TO INVESTIGATE THE RAM PLOT WHICH SCOT.DOS MENTIONED. USE THIS SHIP FOR TRANSPORTATION AND DEFENSE.
'MEET ME IN HQ WHEN YOU ARE READY FOR THE DETAILS OF THIS ASSIGNMENT.'
'I'M IMPRESSED. THE RAM ASTEROID BASE HAS BEEN COMPLETELY ABANDONED, AND YOU HAVE MANAGED TO DEAL WITH TALON.
'I'LL SEE YOU AT HEADQUARTERS FOR A MISSION UPDATE.'
BUCK ROGERS
BUCK LEAVES WITH THE COMMANDER.
AS YOU DEBARK, WILMA CONGRATULATES YOU. 'NOW THAT YOU HAVE DESTROYED THE DOOMSDAY DEVICE, RAM IS CRIPPLED.
'THE ENTIRE SYSTEM IS NOW AWARE OF HOW UNDERHANDEDLY RAM HAS ACTED. IT WILL LOSE MANY IMPORTANT ALLIES.'
TURABIAN COMES UP TO MEET YOU. 'WELCOME BACK. YOU HAVE SAVED EARTH FROM THE EVIL SCOURGE OF RAM...'
BUCK ROGERS SAUNTERS UP AND INTERRUPTS TURABIAN, 'I JUST WANTED TO THANK YOU FOR SAVING EARTH.
'YOU GUYS HAVE THE GUTS AND DETERMINATION I ADMIRE. EARTH WILL BE SAFE AS HEROES LIKE YOU STRIVE TO PROTECT HER.'
NEO TECHNICIANS RUSH UP TO COLLECT THE DEVICE. COMMANDER TURABIAN ARRIVES.
'GOOD WORK! THIS IS VITAL INFORMATION. NOW CONTINUE INVESTIGATING THE DOOMSDAY DEVICE.' HE SHAKES YOUR HAND AND LEAVES.
THE COMMANDER INTERVIEWS JUSTIN, THEN TURNS TO YOU.
'TAKE MR. ROBENO TO THE PAVONIS LIBRARY AND COLLECT HIS DEVICE. IT IS AN IMPORTANT ASSET FOR NEO.'
THANK YOU FOR RESCUING JASON DUPARE.
BEYOND THIS HATCHWAY LIES SALVATION'S HEADQUARTERS.
'TAKE A TUG OUT AND EXPLORE THE DEBRIS IN THE EARTH'S NEAR ORBIT. IF YOU FIND SOMETHING UNUSUAL, INVESTIGATE.'
'DATA INDICATES THREE RAM INSTALLATIONS MAY BE LINKED TO THIS PLOT: ONE NEAR CERES, GRADIVUS MONS ON MARS AND A VENUSIAN BASE.
'THIS SHIP WAS HEADED TO CERES IN THE ASTEROID BELT. I SUGGEST YOU CHECK OUT THE ASTEROID BASE THERE FOR MORE INFORMATION.'
'FROM THE DATA YOU HAVE GATHERED, THE MARS BASE AT GRADIVUS MONS MUST BE INVESTIGATED.
'BE CAREFUL, MARS IS TEEMING WITH RAM AGENTS. BE SURE YOU ARE WELL EQUIPPED BEFORE LANDING THERE.'
'OUR INFORMATION INDICATES THAT THE RAM BASE ON VENUS IS THE PLACE TO GO NEXT.'
'HUER.DOS HAS LOCATED THE DOOMSDAY WEAPON. IT IS IN MARIPOSA 3 AT MERCURY. GO THERE AND DESTROY IT.'
'NOW I WILL TURN YOU OVER TO OUR TRAINING STAFF.'
'JASON DUPARE, A NEO TOP AGENT, HAS PENETRATED RAM'S DOOMSDAY PROJECT. RESCUE HIM FROM THE RADIUM MINES ON THULE AS SOON AS YOU CAN.'

A ROBOT ATTACKS.
RAM HAS A RECEPTION COMMITTEE WAITING FOR YOU.
A VOICE ECHOES THROUGH THE TUNNELS, 'I AM COMMANDER GILBERT. YOU ARE AS FORMIDABLE AS YOUR REPORT INDICATES. YOU HAVE NOW MET YOUR MATCH.'
RAM FORCES ATTACK.
A HORDE OF RABID DESERT APES IS DRIVEN FORWARD BY A ROBOT.
GILBERT LAUGHS, 'A PRESENT FROM THE HOMELAND. YOUR PRIMITIVE IS NOT HERE.'
THE COMMANDER SAYS, 'GETTING WARMER, BUT WRONG.' ANOTHER MINE EXPLODES.
RAM WARRIORS RUSH IN FROM THE OPPOSITE DOOR.
A COMMANDER SPEAKS, 'TALON, FOR YOUR FAILURES THIS BASE IS CONFISCATED AND YOUR LIFE FORFEIT.'
SOMEONE WHISPERS IN HIS EAR. HE LOOKS STARTLED. 'WELL KILL WHOEVER THEY ARE ANYWAY.' HE LEAVES.
THE COMMANDER LOOKS STARTLED WHEN YOU ENTER. 'THIS IS HIGHLY IRREGULAR.'
HE TURNS TO HIS MEN. 'DISPOSE OF THEM. I HAVE A TREASURE TO LOCATE.' HE LEAVES.
DOG GENNIES ATTACK.
THIS ROOM ONCE CONTAINED BUNKS. SHREDDED BEDDING AND BROKEN FRAMES FLOAT AT RANDOM.
THE ROOM IS FULL OF ROBOT MAINTENANCE EQUIPMENT. NO ROBOTS ARE IN EVIDENCE.
THIS IS AN OLD MINE AREA. OLD TAILINGS FLOAT IN THE AIR.
TECHNICIANS ARE WORKING HERE. GUARDS TURN AND ATTACK.
REALIZES THAT THIS CONSOLE IS RELAYING INFORMATION TO SOMETHING NEARBY. YOU CANNOT PINPOINT THE TARGET.
COMMUNICATIONS
NOTES THAT THIS INTERNAL SENSOR SYSTEM IS FEEDING INFORMATION TO THE CONSOLE TO ITS RIGHT.
SENSOR
WEAPONS
THE COMMANDER SCUTTLES THROUGH THE FAR DOOR. HIS GUARDS ATTACK.
MORE FORCES ATTACK.
THE COMMANDER MARSHALS HIS PERSONAL FORCES.
THE COMMANDER COWERS UNDER THE FAR CONSOLE.
A VOICE ISSUES FROM THE CONSOLE, 'I'M GLAD TO SEE MY ENEMIES FIGHTING.
'LITTLE TREASURE REMAINS, BUT YOU MAY HAVE IT ALL!' HE LAUGHS WILDLY.
HIDDEN WALL PANELS SLIDE OPEN. A ROBOT SCUTTLES OUT AND BLASTS THE COMMANDER TO ASHES.
'READINGS INDICATE HIGH RADIATION. THIS IS DEFINITELY A RADIUM MINE. DON'T WASTE TIME!'
A ROBOT INTONES, 'THIS IS A RESTRICTED AREA. I WILL USE DEADLY FORCE.'
AN ALARM HAS BEEN RAISED. ROBOTS CONVERGE ON YOU.
THE WALLS ARE MARKED WITH RADIATION SIGNS. YOUR SKIN PRICKLES.
HAIRLESS BODIES ARE VIRTUALLY MUMMIFIED IN THE DRY AIR.
A MAN IS CRUSHED BETWEEN TWO BOULDERS. HE HAS SOME EQUIPMENT.
ANOTHER ROBOT BLOCKS YOUR PATH.
THIS RADIATION MONITOR IS WELL INTO THE FATAL RANGE.
THIS CONSOLE CONTROLS AN INTERNAL DEFENSE MECHANISM. DO YOU WANT TO REPROGRAM IT TO ACCEPT YOU?
SUCCEEDS. THE SYSTEM RECOGNIZES YOU AS FRIENDLY.
YOU PROVE UNSUCCESSFUL. A ROBOT IS ALERTED.
AN AUTOMATIC DEFENSE SYSTEM LOCKS ONTO YOU AND FIRES.
THE WEAPONS DRIVE YOU BACK.
THE WEAPONS REMAIN INACTIVE.
YOU FIND JASON DUPARE. HE IS EXTREMELY EMACIATED. 'RAM IS BUILDING A DEADLY DEVICE OVER MERCURY. WARN NEO.'
HE FAINTS AND YOU CARRY HIM.
YOU FIND ANOTHER WEAK PRISONER HERE. HE THANKS YOU PROFUSELY.
'INTRUDER ALERT!' AS YOU ENTER THE CRUDE BASE, ALARMS BLARE. A WALL PANEL OPENS AND A ROBOT EMERGES.
ALARMS CONTINUE TO BLARE.
THE WALLS ARE LINED WITH CAGED DESERT APES. THEIR TRAINER OPENS THE CAGES AND RUNS AWAY.
SHRIEKING DESERT APES THROW HANDFULS OF DIRT AND PEBBLES AT THE TEAM, THEN RUN AWAY.
THE DESERT APES COWER AGAINST THE FAR WALL OF THE CAGE.
DESERT APES WATCH YOU PITEOUSLY FROM TINY, DIRTY CAGES. OPEN THE CAGES?
THE APES SWING OVER YOUR HEADS AND ATTACK!
THIS ROOM IS FULL OF BACKUP COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT. IT IS GUARDED BY A ROBOT!
YOU SMASH THE BACKUP EQUIPMENT.
YOU STARTLE THE BASE COMMANDER. HE RETREATS THROUGH THE FAR DOOR, LEAVING HIS GUARDS TO FIGHT.
YOU USE THE CONTROL PANEL TO CONTACT NEO. THEY CONGRATULATE YOU AND BEGIN TO REVIEW PAST COMMUNICATIONS FOR SECURITY LEAKS.
WHEN YOUR TRANSMISSION IS COMPLETE, YOU SMASH THE PANEL.
THE COMMANDER HASTENS THROUGH ANOTHER DOOR. A GUARD ROBOT INTERRUPTS YOUR PURSUIT.
YOU SMASH MORE COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT.
THE COMMANDER FLEES INTO YET ANOTHER ROOM. NO GUARDS ARE PRESENT. YOU DESTROY THE EQUIPMENT IN THE ROOM.
THE COMMANDER SUMMONS THE LAST OF HIS GUARDS, A SMALL GROUP OF UNPREPARED TECHNICIANS.
THE COMMANDER TRIES TO SHIELD HIMSELF BEHIND THE LAST OF THE COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT.
YOU ANNIHILATE HIM AND THE EQUIPMENT IN A BARRAGE OF FIRE.
SAND SQUIDS ARE BEING USED TO DRILL TUNNELS IN THE ASTEROID. THEIR TRAINERS DIRECT THEM TOWARDS THE TEAM.
YOU NOTICE A CACHE OF HIDDEN GRENADES.
FROM YOUR RIGHT COMES SNIPER FIRE.
YOU CATCH UP WITH THE SNIPERS. FROM BEHIND, MORE ENEMY APPEAR.
THE COMMANDER'S SWEET VOICE PURRS, 'SO MUCH EFFORT TO RESCUE A PRIMITIVE. THAT IS WHY RAM SHALL PROVE VICTORIOUS.'
ROBOTS EMERGE FROM BENEATH THE TUNNEL. GILBERT LAUGHS, 'ARE THINGS GETTING WARMER?'
A MINE EXPLODES!
COMBAT GENNIES ATTACK.
'YOU ARE PERSISTENT! AND GETTING WARMER!' AN AMUSED VOICE LAUGHS.
A ROBOT CUTS OFF YOUR ESCAPE.
COMMANDER GILBERT IS HERE HOLDING ATHA. A CAGED DESERT APE IS BEHIND THEM.
GILBERT TOSSES ATHA INTO THE CAGE AND SAYS, 'ALL YOUR EFFORT WAS FOR NOUGHT! WATCH HER DEATH AND LEARN RAM'S STRENGTH!'
A CLEAR SHIELD DESCENDS IN FRONT OF GILBERT AND GUNS POP FROM THE WALLS. SHE READIES A CONTROL BOX. 'HAVE ONE LAST BATTLE. THEN YOU DIE!'
A ROBOT ENTERS.
GILBERT SMILES AND HER FINGER DESCENDS TOWARD THE BUTTON.
A PUZZLED EXPRESSION CROSSES HER FACE AND SHE COLLAPSES. ATHA IS BEHIND HER, HOLDING THE BROKEN ARM SPIKE OF THE APE.
SHE SMILES AND PLAYS WITH THE SPIKE. 'SHE OVERESTIMATED THE APE'S STRENGTH.'
'I REQUIRE YOUR HELP IN GETTING TO AN OUTPOST. FRIENDS WILL HELP ME BACK TO MARS.'
DESPITE HER BRAVADO, ATHA IS BADLY WOUNDED AND YOU AID HER TO THE SHIP. SHE BEGRUDGINGLY THANKS YOU. THE BOX OPENS THE AIRLOCK.
DO YOU WISH TO RETURN TO YOUR SHIP?
THE LOCK IS SEALED. YOU WILL NEED TO FIND THE CONTROLS TO OPEN IT.
